title: ChatLog
description: log (since 1.6): a note of the server in her conversation, such as the user's approval of a task. Not an exchange: never given to the model, not counted as her being talked to. In the history it is a ChatEntry of the type log.

sentAt.description: When it happened (ISO 8601 date and time).

kind.description: What kind of note (task.approved, task.auto_approved...); a client shows the text of a kind it does not know.
